answer.justification: Only logit-level data is available. Top-1 agreement of 0.936 and sequence agreement of 0.609 fall in the fine-tuned ranges (0.900-0.938 and 0.47-0.64). They are above the system-prompted range (0.861-0.908, 0.31-0.48) and below the quantized range (0.945-0.955, 0.67-0.70). KL of 0.094 fits fine-tuned (0.081-0.205) and is above the quantized range (0.039-0.071) and well below the system-prompted range (0.197-0.339). TV of 0.061 is a bit low for fine-tuned (0.076-0.099) and sits between quantized (0.048-0.055) and fine-tuned. Raw-score shift ÷ TV of 4.3 is outside the quantized range (2.2-2.3) but inside the fine-tuned range (3.1-10.8). Token-DiFR gap of 0.071 is below the fine-tuned range (0.10-0.31) and above the quantized range (0.03-0.04). Nothing is exactly 0, so base is ruled out. Quantized is the closest alternative, since TV and DiFR lean that way, but KL and the raw-score ratio favor fine-tuned.
